CHART.description: Chart (CHART). Generates or retrieves a user chart (UCHT) and returns its tabular data; the request either builds a new chart when CHART_TYPE is assigned or looks up an existing one by CHART_NAME, with the time-history story graph driven by TH_STORY_GRAPH.

EXPORT_PATH_GRAPH.description: Optional file path to export the graph image (BMP only). When assigned, the chart graph is written to this path.

EXPORT_PATH_JSON.description: Optional file path to export the chart data as JSON. When assigned, the response chart data is serialized to this path.

CHART_NAME.description: Chart name. When CHART_TYPE is not assigned, the existing chart with this name is looked up; also used as the graph title fallback.

CHART_TYPE.description: Chart type. Only ONE value is accepted server-side: 'THSTORYGRAPH' (resolved via __caChartStrType after normalization = uppercase + remove-all-spaces, so 'TH Story Graph' / 'th story graph' also work). Any other value throws. When assigned, a new chart (UCHT) is built from TH_STORY_GRAPH; when OMITTED, the existing chart named CHART_NAME is looked up instead — so leave CHART_TYPE unset to fetch a previously created chart by name.

UNIT.description: Optional user-defined unit override applied while building the chart data.

TH_STORY_GRAPH.description: Time history story graph definition. Consumed only when CHART_TYPE='THSTORYGRAPH' (build path); ignored on the lookup-by-name path. Only CASE=3 (Story Displ/Vel/Accel) is functional — CASE 0/1/2 are accepted but return empty data (silent no-op), and CASE outside 0-3 errors.

CASE.description: Graph case: 0=Story Shear/Overturning Mom.(by Step), 1=Story Shear(Max.), 2=Shear Factor, 3=Story Displ/Vel/Accel. Only CASE 3 is functional; 0/1/2 return empty data.

GRAPH_TITLE.description: Graph title. If empty, follows CHART_NAME.

THNAME.description: Time History Case Name. Must resolve to an existing Time History load case (non-zero internal key) or the call fails.
